choices: Sea told me to come to the student council room
Go to the library to see Yuna
Stop by to say hello to Ms. Eunsu

day1_after_sea_1.text: *A small room. Two desks, a locker, a plant by the window. Neatly organized.*

day1_after_sea_2.text: You made it. This is the student council room.

day1_after_sea_3.text:
*She hands me a canned drink. The tab has already been lifted a little, so it’ll open easily.*

Thanks. You already popped the tab. Feels a little awkward just taking it.

day1_after_sea_4.text: So, how are you settling in?

day1_after_sea_5.text: I'm doing all right so far. You've helped me out. All the names and buildings at once are a little confusing. I can ask again, right?

day1_after_sea_7.text: *Sea lets out a small breath and smiles.*

day1_after_sea_8.text: The first day is always like that. You keep checking where to sit and who you're supposed to greet.

day1_after_sea_9.text:
*Sea looks out the window. The sunset light streams in.*

It's quiet. Are you here alone at this hour? Don't you get bored?

day1_after_sea_10.text: At this hour, the fluorescent lights are the only thing you can hear.

day1_after_sea_11.text: Where are the other council members? Do they all leave right after school?

day1_after_sea_12.text: There are some, but... I'm the only one who comes here after school.

day1_after_sea_13.text: Could you stop by again tomorrow?

day1_after_sea_14.text: Sure, if I have time. I can't promise I'll be good at something I haven't tried. Show me where the papers go and I'll give it a go.

day1_after_sea_15.text: Then I'll save a few forms for you.

day1_after_sea_16.text:
*Sea rolled the empty can between her hands while waiting for my answer.*

Leave them here. I’ll look tomorrow.

day1_after_yuna_1.text:
*Yuna is organizing photos at a window seat.*

Were you sorting your photos? Am I interrupting? I just stopped by; can I sit here?

day1_after_yuna_3.text:
*Yuna hands me the camera. Photos of the school, cherry blossoms, and cats follow one after another.*

Does this cat live here too?

day1_after_yuna_4.text: This cat is Cheese. I named him.

day1_after_yuna_5.text:
*Yuna tells me each cat's name as she scrolls through the photos. The camera strap sways lightly at her wrist.*

You named all the cats?

day1_after_yuna_6.text: You'll come to the library again tomorrow, right?

day1_after_yuna_7.text: Yeah, if I have time. I thought I might be in the way, so I'm glad I can come.

day1_after_yuna_9.text:
*She stresses the word 'please.' Yuna winds the camera strap twice around her finger, then lets it go.*

All right. You don't have to say it like that. Loosen the strap a little.

day1_after_yuna_10.text: *As I leave the library, Yuna follows me out.*

day1_after_yuna_12.text:
*Yuna holds out a Polaroid photo. It's the view from the library window earlier.*

Can I keep this?

day1_after_yuna_13.text: This is the seat where you were sitting, sunbae. The light falls nicely there. You can keep it.

day1_after_yuna_14.text: *I take the photo. Sunlight falls diagonally across a book. A tiny timestamp is printed along the edge.*

day1_after_riin_1.text:
*I drink herbal tea with Nurse Riin. Wisps of steam rise from the rim of the paper cup.*

The tea's warm. I wasn't sure where to sit. Is it all right if I stay?

day1_after_riin_2.text: You might not sleep well after your first day at a new school. The body notices an unfamiliar place before the mind does.

day1_after_riin_3.text: I'm all right so far. I'll know better when I get home. Can I come just to talk, before anything's wrong? The tea makes it feel comfortable here.

day1_after_riin_5.text:
*She pauses, then opens the cabinet.*

What are you looking for? I said I was fine.

day1_after_riin_7.text:
*She hands me a small bag. A few herbal tea bags.*

I hope I can finish these… Oh, you mean I should try them at home? I feel bad just leaving when you've packed tea for me too.

day1_after_riin_8.text: If you can't sleep well, brew a cup before bed. It's chamomile.

day1_after_riin_10.text:
*Nurse Riin puts on a quiet piano piece. The volume is so low that the beat reaches me before the melody.*

The piano's quiet. I think that suits this room. Thank you for the tea, too.

day1_after_riin_11.text: Come by around this time again. I'll make tea.

day1_after_riin_12.text:
I'll be going, then. I'll put the tea somewhere safe at home. The packet's thin; I'd better be careful with it in my bag.

*Nurse Riin holds the door for me. As I walk down the hall, I fiddle with the packet of tea bags. Dry leaves crackle inside.*

day1_after_eunsu_1.text: {name}? You came to see me after school? Is something wrong?

day1_after_eunsu_2.text:
*She makes coffee as she asks.*

How was your old school? How long does it take you to get here? What did you have for breakfast?

day1_after_eunsu_3.text: The paperwork from your old school came in late. Did something happen?

day1_after_eunsu_4.text: What do you mean? I came because my parents moved. If the papers said something else, I think I should know too.

day1_after_eunsu_6.text:
*The teacher sets down her coffee cup and closes the folder.*

Did I interrupt your work? Can those papers wait? I'll keep this brief.

day1_after_eunsu_7.text: Oh right, {name}, did you get all your textbooks?

day1_after_eunsu_8.text: Yes, Sea took care of everything.

day1_after_eunsu_9.text: Sea's been looking after you. If anything is difficult, come to me. I'm your homeroom teacher.

day1_after_eunsu_10.text:
*Ms. Eunsu smiles and pats me on the back. The warmth of her palm lingers for a moment in the pressed fabric.*

Yes, Miss. Sea helped me find my way today. I'm still a bit overwhelmed, but tomorrow should be easier.

day1_after_home_1.text: *Walking out the school gate, I glance back.*

day1_after_home_3.text: *Someone is standing at a third-floor window, looking down at me.*

day1_after_home_4.text: *The backlight hides the face. Just a silhouette. Near the window seat in the very back row.*

day1_after_home_6.text: *I don’t wait any longer. I turn and head home.*

day1_after_sea_walk_1.text: *Sea picked up both empty cans and offered to walk me to the gate. Our sleeves brushed in the corridor.*

day1_after_sea_walk_2.text: A tour of the gate, too? I can find that much myself.

day1_after_sea_walk_3.text: I’m going home too. Can you let the class president clock out?

day1_after_sea_walk_4.text: *At the stairs, Sea stepped aside. She waited against the railing while I adjusted my bag.*

day1_after_eunsu_counsel_1.text: You can leave the career box blank. Today, picking the bus home is plenty.

day1_after_eunsu_counsel_2.text: I learned that one by taking the wrong bus this morning.

day1_after_eunsu_counsel_3.text: Then that’s one thing done. Mark anything you get stuck on in class. We’ll look at it together.

day1_after_yuna_cat_1.text: Does Cheese come when you call?

day1_after_yuna_cat_2.text: If a bag rustles. We’re still negotiating the name.

day1_after_yuna_cat_3.text: *Cheese had his back to the lens. Yuna showed me the next shot: his nose was so close that the whole frame was pink.*

day1_after_sea_cabinet_choice.text: *Sea put the stack of application forms into the metal cabinet and turned the key.*
choices: Look at the box of old name tags on the bottom shelf
Look at the plastic label in the flowerpot by the window

day1_after_sea_cab_1.text: What's that plastic box on the bottom shelf? It's full of name tags.

day1_after_sea_cab_2.text: *Sea bent her knees and pushed the cabinet door half shut.*

day1_after_sea_cab_3.text: Spare name tags and temporary numbers for sports day. We collect them to use again every year.

day1_after_sea_cab_5.text: They belonged to students who transferred, or they were printed wrong. I haven't had time to sort them, so I keep them together.

day1_after_sea_cab_6.text: A lot of students must have transferred.

day1_after_sea_cab_7.text: I couldn't say. I haven't counted them all.

day1_after_sea_cab_8.text: Why does that flowerpot by the window only have a date on it? Not the plant's name?

day1_after_sea_cab_9.text: *Sea looked toward the window. The soil was dark and wet, as if it had just been watered.*

day1_after_sea_cab_10.text: I write down when I water it. It wilts fast if I forget.

day1_after_sea_cab_11.text: There are several erased lines above yesterday's date. Do you erase it and write it again every day?

day1_after_sea_cab_12.text: There's only one label. No need to put in a new one.

day1_after_sea_cab_13.text: *Sea put the bunch of keys in her pencil case and pulled the zipper all the way shut.*

day1_after_sea_cab_14.text: Let's go. We should leave before the caretaker locks the main building.

day1_after_yuna_back_choice.text: *I turned over the Polaroid Yuna had given me in my palm.*
choices: Ask about the penciled number in the corner of the photo’s back
Ask about the keys jingling in Yuna’s bag

day1_after_yuna_back_1.text: Yuna, there's a tiny '13' in pencil on the back. Is that the film number?

day1_after_yuna_back_2.text: *Yuna slowed her steps for half a beat.*

day1_after_yuna_back_3.text: Yes. There are ten shots in a pack. I lose track of which pack it is, so I write it down.

day1_after_yuna_back_4.text: Your thirteenth pack? You've taken a lot of pictures.

day1_after_yuna_back_5.text: Photos are all that stay. Memories fade faster than you think.

day1_after_yuna_back_6.text: That picture by the library window came out nice and sharp, though.

day1_after_yuna_back_7.text: Use it as a bookmark. It'll last a long time between the pages of a thick book, where it won't get bent.

day1_after_yuna_back_8.text: Something metal keeps clinking in your bag. Do you have a lot of keys?

day1_after_yuna_back_9.text: *Yuna cupped a hand over her side pocket to muffle the noise.*

day1_after_yuna_back_10.text: They're for the photography clubroom and darkroom in the old building. I'm the only member, so I carry all of them.

day1_after_yuna_back_11.text: There's a separate darkroom? Doesn't everyone shoot digital now?

day1_after_yuna_back_12.text: With digital, one person can delete everything. Developed film doesn't disappear unless someone destroys it by hand.

day1_after_yuna_back_13.text: *At the entrance shoe lockers, Yuna adjusted her grip on her slipper bag.*

day1_after_yuna_back_14.text: I'm stopping by the old building. Sunbae, leave through the front gate before sunset.

day1_after_yuna_back_15.text: Okay. See you in the library tomorrow.

day1_after_riin_tea_choice.text: *Two tea bags lay stacked inside the translucent medicine pouch Ms. Riin had handed me.*
choices: Ask about the blue stamped numbers on the pouch
Ask the name of the piano piece playing through the speaker

day1_after_riin_tea_1.text: Ms. Riin, is the date stamped in the corner when it was made?

day1_after_riin_tea_2.text: *Ms. Riin glanced at the pouch as she put the lid on the teapot.*

day1_after_riin_tea_3.text: When it arrived in the supply room. We have to stamp the opening date on all infirmary supplies.

day1_after_riin_tea_5.text: Students drink it, after all. This school is especially particular about records.

day1_after_riin_tea_7.text: Once you get used to it, your hands do it for you. You reach for the stamp without thinking.

day1_after_riin_tea_8.text: What's this piano piece called? It sounds like the same section keeps repeating.

day1_after_riin_tea_9.text: *Ms. Riin rested her fingertips on the speaker volume knob.*

day1_after_riin_tea_10.text: It's music to help you sleep, so the musical measures keep flowing into one another. There isn't a separate ending.

day1_after_riin_tea_11.text: Listening to it does make me drowsy.

day1_after_riin_tea_12.text: Right? When your pulse is fast, playing it soon steadies your breathing.

day1_after_riin_tea_13.text: *She stacked the empty paper cups beside the sink.*

day1_after_riin_tea_14.text: Even if you don't sleep well tonight, you'll wake up on time tomorrow. Don't worry. Get some sleep.

day1_after_eunsu_file_choice.text: *White eraser crumbs lay in a small heap beside a folder on Ms. Eunsu's desk.*
choices: Point to the eraser crumbs at the corner of the folder
Ask why the staffroom clock is five minutes fast

day1_after_eunsu_file_1.text: Ms. Eunsu, do you write my counseling record in pencil? There are a lot of eraser crumbs.

day1_after_eunsu_file_2.text: *Ms. Eunsu brushed the corner of her desk with the back of her hand.*

day1_after_eunsu_file_3.text: I draft it in pencil. Plenty of students look different a week later than they do on the first day.

day1_after_eunsu_file_4.text: What did you write in mine?

day1_after_eunsu_file_5.text: That's a secret. I'll let you see it when you're about to graduate.

day1_after_eunsu_file_6.text: Graduation's still a long way off.

day1_after_eunsu_file_7.text: School days go faster than you think. Before you know it, it'll be Friday evening.

day1_after_eunsu_file_8.text: Is that clock supposed to be five minutes fast? It doesn't match the hallway clock.

day1_after_eunsu_file_9.text: *Ms. Eunsu looked up at the second hand on the wall clock.*

day1_after_eunsu_file_10.text: Only the staffroom clock runs a little fast. We have to get moving before the bell so we aren't late for class.

day1_after_eunsu_file_11.text: Even teachers worry about being late.

day1_after_eunsu_file_12.text: The class gets anxious if their homeroom teacher is late. They feel better when you're in the right place at the right time.

day1_after_eunsu_file_13.text: *She picked up her cup of cold coffee and carried it toward the sink.*

day1_after_eunsu_file_14.text: You must be tired after your first day. Go home early and rest. See you at homeroom tomorrow.
